full_judgment: 4. We have considered the prayer for amendment and also the fact that the suit in which the deed under preemption was declared as an out and out sale deed and not a deed of exchange was bought up to this Court and was filed in 1993. It further appears that in the amendment application the pre-emptee took a fresh plea that the pre-emption application was barred under the principle of estoppel, waiver and acquiescence by referring to a judgment and decree passed in a suit in 2002.
